I am an old woman of 81 years here in Kigoma, farming this small piece of land with my family. I have no money for chemical fertilizer — we have never used such things here, and the shops are far. I will plant my own seeds that I saved from last harvest, mixed together as we always do, and we will weed by hand. My grandchildren help me when they can, but my body is tired and I cannot work as I used to.
